# Gramya Sarvodaya Foundation

> Inspired by Gandhian philosophy, Gramya Sarvodaya Foundation works towards creating self-reliant villages through sustainable agriculture, rural entrepreneurship, education, environmental conservation, community empowerment and inclusive development.

Gramya Sarvodaya Foundation is a rural development-oriented organization dedicated to promoting inclusive, sustainable and community-led development.

Office: Bhatemora, Pulibor, Jorhat, Assam – 785006, India. Email: gramyasarvodaya@gmail.com. Phone: +91 96780 70943.

## About

- [About us](https://www.gramyasarvodaya.org/about/): who the Foundation is, its philosophy, Gandhian ideology, vision and mission
- [Our approach](https://www.gramyasarvodaya.org/approach/): how the Foundation works with communities
- [Get involved](https://www.gramyasarvodaya.org/get-involved/): volunteering, partnerships and support
- [Contact](https://www.gramyasarvodaya.org/contact/): email, phone and office address

## Programmes

- [Sustainable Agriculture & Natural Farming](https://www.gramyasarvodaya.org/programmes/sustainable-agriculture/): We promote environmentally responsible agriculture that improves soil health, conserves water and strengthens farmers' livelihoods.
- [Farmer Producer Company (FPC) Support](https://www.gramyasarvodaya.org/programmes/farmer-producer-company/): We encourage farmers to work collectively through Farmer Producer Companies and producer institutions.
- [Farm Field School (FFS)](https://www.gramyasarvodaya.org/programmes/farm-field-school/): Farm Field School is a participatory learning approach that allows farmers to learn directly from agricultural fields.
- [Agro Tourism](https://www.gramyasarvodaya.org/programmes/agro-tourism/): We promote agro-tourism as an alternative rural livelihood and an opportunity to connect visitors with agriculture, culture and nature.
- [Green Education](https://www.gramyasarvodaya.org/programmes/green-education/): We believe education should develop environmental responsibility, practical knowledge and sustainable lifestyles.
- [Gramya Udyog – Rural Industries](https://www.gramyasarvodaya.org/programmes/gramya-udyog/): Gramya Udyog focuses on developing village-based industries by utilizing local resources, traditional skills and modern technologies.
- [Natural Wellness Initiative](https://www.gramyasarvodaya.org/programmes/wellness/): We envision promoting holistic wellness through nature-based living, preventive health awareness and responsible traditional wellness practices.
- [Community Financial Inclusion](https://www.gramyasarvodaya.org/programmes/financial-inclusion/): We promote financial literacy, responsible savings habits, entrepreneurship awareness and access to appropriate financial services.
- [Women's Empowerment](https://www.gramyasarvodaya.org/programmes/womens-empowerment/): Women are essential contributors to rural economic and social development.
- [Youth Empowerment & Skill Development](https://www.gramyasarvodaya.org/programmes/youth-empowerment/): We work towards creating opportunities for rural youth through education, skills and entrepreneurship.
- [Environmental Conservation & Renewable Energy](https://www.gramyasarvodaya.org/programmes/environment/): We promote responsible use of natural resources and environmentally sustainable development.
- [Waste-to-Wealth & Circular Economy](https://www.gramyasarvodaya.org/programmes/waste-to-wealth/): We encourage communities to transform waste materials into useful products and economic opportunities.
